coveredGames.name: Football Manager 27
coveredGames.title: The pillar that the series needed. It fixes most of the issues of previous iteration while being able to juggle the fan favorite features of the past and a modern presentation. Well done.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: Spectacular combat and bosses, cinematic aesthetic (in the good way) and a Kung Fu vibe that will keep every action RPG enthusiast glued to their seat.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Great Castlevania experience with modern graphics and classic 2D nod as well. Great music, and a feeling that you're always achieving something new, although some might not enjoy the heavy platforming

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant
coveredGames.title: STILL delightfully weird. Fight your way through a bizarre paranormal Manhattan and enjoy amazing aesthetics, level design and character movement. Includes MFG, DLSS 4.5 and RT.

coveredGames.name: DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH
coveredGames.title: Classic Kojami. Fun, beautiful, exciting, weird, sad. All in equal amounts.

coveredGames.name: Schrödinger's Call
coveredGames.title: A lovely visual novel. Beautifully presented and emotional. It can be repetitive, and a bit linear, but for the right person, it's a great experience. Has a demo for you to find out if that's you.

coveredGames.name: Forza Horizon 6
coveredGames.title: More Forza, for Forza fans. If you're already into Forza/enjoy arcade racing games, you can't really go wrong with it, and will play it plenty, otherwise, skip it. The Japan map is beautiful.

coveredGames.name: Mixtape
coveredGames.title: An interactive art project (more so than a game) that captures a moment in time in the 90's if you are a middle class teenager living in Suburbia. Has great music, nice visuals, but no gameplay.

coveredGames.name: PRAGMATA
coveredGames.title: Battle rogue AI with your adorable sidekick in this single-player adventure that combines action and puzzles (not too hard) at the same time, but does so without interrupting the flow of the game.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
coveredGames.title: If you're looking for a crafted narrative with tight controls, look elsewhere. Looking for a massive action-adventure sandbox to play around and get lost in for 100+ hours? You are in the right spot.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: Grace and Leon have different play styles, which is a theme of the game, since it pulls various things in previous entries, throws everything at a wall, and it all sticks. Has path Tracing&DLSS4 MFG.

coveredGames.name: ARC Raiders
coveredGames.title: Established itself as THE extraction shooter to play in 2025. Action packed and addictive with friends (and even alone). A great multiplayer experience. It features DLSS 4 w/ Multi Frame Gen & Reflex.

coveredGames.name: Dispatch
coveredGames.title: In the style of classics like Wolf Among Us and Walking Dead, Manage and dispatch the right heroes for the job on a mission to become one again yourself. A great story with a fun cast of characters.

coveredGames.name: Borderlands 4
coveredGames.title: Despite the launch pains, what Borderlands fans love is back: the self aware humor, paired with very fun combat, gunplay and looting. It features DLSS 4 w/ Multi Frame Gen (particularly handy here).

coveredGames.name: The Outer Worlds 2
coveredGames.title: Obsidian's RPG chops shine again. Good writing and choice-based mechanics that meet improved gunplay, abilities, perks, and traits/flaws. This is the game that Outer Worlds 1 should have been.

coveredGames.name: BALL x PIT
coveredGames.title: An addictive and well-priced roguelike. It has elements of Arkanoid mixed with light base building, and it makes you want to do just another run for treasure in the pit that used to be Ballbylon.

coveredGames.name: Megabonk
coveredGames.title: Cheap, fast, rewarding, and runs on a potato PC. The kind of game you play to have some mindless fun for 30 minutes, then move on, then do it again the next day. It would be even better with co-op.

coveredGames.name: Battlefield™ 6
coveredGames.title: A return to form for one of the great multiplayer shooters. Has NVIDIA DLSS 4, Multi Frame Gen & Reflex, feels hectic, chaotic, explosive, and fun, at a scale that only Battlefield seems to get right.

coveredGames.name: ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN
coveredGames.title: A standalone Elden Ring DLC. Many have tried to emulate the genre, but no one does it quite like FromSoftware. An unapologetic, excruciatingly hard, beautiful piece of art, just like the main game.

coveredGames.name: SILENT HILL 2
coveredGames.title: The remake of one of the great horror games of all time is a masterpiece in its own right. If you're even remotely interested in the genre and have never played this, make sure you do so.

coveredGames.name: No, I'm not a Human
coveredGames.title: Has an interesting, psychological horror premise and great ambiance, but fails to remain engaging for more than a few hours. For the right price, it's good fun. Make sure you feed the kitty!

coveredGames.name: Hades II
coveredGames.title: Figh. Die. Become stronger. Get further. Start over. It uses the same basics as its brilliant predecessor and seems to improve on it in most fronts. A beautiful, frantic, addictive, and fun roguelike.

coveredGames.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
coveredGames.title: Both this and the original are amazing games, which you prefer will probably depend on if you prefer the platform and exploration aspects (Original) or the combat and much harder difficulty (Silksong)

coveredGames.name: Cast n Chill
coveredGames.title: Vibey but not overly simplistic fishing game that nails the "chill" aspect. Great candidate for second screen idle play while working (yes, we know you do it). Also you can pet the dogs, which is nice

coveredGames.name: Mewgenics
coveredGames.title: Wonderful. Probably the biggest and craziest roguelite on the market

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
coveredGames.title: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE is the epitome of an old-school JRPG, with an elegant twist in the second half. Brilliant story, fantastic gameplay – Final Fantasy at its best.

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: Chain dual-blade strikes, swap to heavy phantom weapons mid-air, and execute cinematic parry counters — Phantom Blade Zero thrives on rhythm, timing, and relentless aggression.

coveredGames.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4
coveredGames.title: The best Call of Duty Modern Warfare in 10 years. Extremely good campaign.

coveredGames.name: CONTROL Resonant
coveredGames.title: Surreal worlds, supernatural powers, and psychological mysteries. A story that pulls you in, challenges your perception, and stays with you long after the credits roll. 9/10

coveredGames.name: Gears of War: E-Day
coveredGames.title: Definitely no masterpiece, but not all bad either. It misses its target audience in places, with odd backstories and an MP horde mode that needs work. Still, far from a complete disaster. 7/10

coveredGames.name: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
coveredGames.title: The Yakuza series stands for quality, dark humor, and long playtime—and that’s exactly what you get in one of the best and craziest entries in the series. 9/10

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
coveredGames.title: Who would’ve thought? But it’s one of the best turn-based tactical RPGs with XCOM-style mechanics out there. Absolutely recommend buying it. Must-have 9/10

coveredGames.name: How to Fish
coveredGames.title: Behind the cozy aesthetic lies a brilliant masterclass in pacing. How to Fish seamlessly bridges relaxing cozy mechanics with a deeply rewarding collection system

coveredGames.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
coveredGames.title: Behind the familiar fantasy branding lies a brilliant masterclass in survival progression. Dragonwilds seamlessly bridges classic RuneScape skill loops with modern open-world mechanics.

coveredGames.name: Adaptory
coveredGames.title: Oxygen Not Included copycat where the player manages a squad of survivors stranded on an asteroid in space.

coveredGames.name: WARDOGS
coveredGames.title: The servers are overloaded for good reason. This isn’t just another generic hero shooter with Extraction or Battle Royale mechanics. It’s a tactical FPS with up to 100 players and 3 teams. Pure fun.

coveredGames.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
coveredGames.title: A completely new gaming experience, featuring an innovative system that changes the way you can play and complete the game. Nothing like this has ever been done before.

coveredGames.name: Windbound
coveredGames.title: Windbound combines detailed sailing-crafting mechanics with an ambitious fantasy framework that gives the modern survival-adventure genre a refreshing layer of visual and mechanical identity

coveredGames.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
coveredGames.title: Not some generic, run-of-the-mill crap like the failed multiplayer game Marvel’s Avengers. Pure single-player gaming at its finest, and rarely have I seen so much love and attention to detail. Top!

coveredGames.name: Medieval Dynasty
coveredGames.title: Blending first-person action, village automation, hunting mechanics, and dynasty planning, it delivers impressive long-term value for dedicated simulation enthusiasts.

coveredGames.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
coveredGames.title: The best Assassin’s Creed game of all time is back as a high-quality remake — highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy

coveredGames.name: The Referee Committee
coveredGames.title: Text based game in which the player assigns referees to matches, receives requests for a pre-determined outcome, and can make VAR rulings for an advantageous outcome.

coveredGames.name: Bodycam
coveredGames.title: One of the most realistic FPS games ever made

coveredGames.name: Once Human

coveredGames.name: PatriotMemoirs
coveredGames.title: A really well-made FMV set during World War II. Very exciting, with great 4K quality.

coveredGames.name: Servant of the Lake
coveredGames.title: A new Rusty Lake adventure always means great entertainment, clever puzzles, and a wonderfully freaky story that’s truly one of a kind. Simply brilliant! 9/10

coveredGames.name: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator

coveredGames.name: Crusaders Quest : Hero Town
coveredGames.title: Clear, visually engaging, and packed with content for a desktop companion—offering pleasant company while you work.

coveredGames.name: Mistfall Hunter
coveredGames.title: A fantastic game with innovative gameplay and fresh ideas that bring something new to the genre. Soulslike and extraction mechanics work incredibly well together. Highly recommended.

coveredGames.name: DragonSword : Awakening
coveredGames.title: Visually magnificent and mechanically exhilarating premium game and not some F2P Gacha, DragonSword: Awakening sets an impressive benchmark for fast-paced character action games. 9/10

coveredGames.name: Stellar Blade™

coveredGames.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III

coveredGames.name: Windrose

coveredGames.name: Slotbound

coveredGames.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim

coveredGames.name: Echo Mates

coveredGames.name: GloveUp!

coveredGames.name: Eternal Palace Sakura

coveredGames.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows

coveredGames.name: ATMOSFAR

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2

coveredGames.name: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths

coveredGames.name: Coal Duty

coveredGames.name: No Such Place

coveredGames.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway

coveredGames.name: Good Heavens!

coveredGames.name: Duelist: Idle Expedition

coveredGames.name: Transport Fever 3

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator

coveredGames.name: Purr-fect Chef: Kitchen Chaos

coveredGames.name: Creator Chronicles

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027

coveredGames.name: Land of Glarefall

coveredGames.name: 33 Days till Extraction

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator

coveredGames.name: Deck & Conn

coveredGames.name: No Asteroids
coveredGames.title: Saving Earth from an apocalypse on a self-funded contract is hilarious. The progression feels so rewarding and watching the massive counter rapidly drop keeps you hooked.

coveredGames.name: SHRED A BILLION
coveredGames.title: Starting with bare hands and slowly working your way up to shovels, vacuums, and drones is delightfully addictive.

coveredGames.name: Till the End
coveredGames.title: The contrast between agile sword strikes, mystical energy projectiles and heavy firepower gives good variety to gameplay.

coveredGames.name: System Arrival
coveredGames.title: Exploring ruins and managing my underground shelter with friends makes for an extraordinarily addictive loop.

coveredGames.name: Evenicle - Next Fragment Medica
coveredGames.title: Fantastic return to the world of Evenicle. Traveling across six massive continents feels great and the party banter kept me smiling the entire way through.

coveredGames.name: Pool of Madness
coveredGames.title: If you ever wondered what Balatro crossed with Lovecraftian dread would look like, this is your answer.

coveredGames.name: Monkeys!¡
coveredGames.title: Monkeys! proves that a visual novels can leave a good impression. The humor is absurd, cheerful and charmingly wholesome throughout.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: Slotbound delivers non-stop entertainment with its unique hybrid mechanics. Stacking random unit stats and watching explosive core synergies rip through waves feels great.

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake
coveredGames.title: Gothic 1 Remake was almost cancelled at one point, but the final version of the game is worth a try.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Cooking with alien ingredients while trying to fund a journey home gives its culinary chaos an appealing concept.

coveredGames.name: Lost Liminal
coveredGames.title: A wandering threat and a camera full of investigative functions make an interesting pairing.

coveredGames.name: FIRE AND ASHES
coveredGames.title: For fans of story-focused horror, Henry’s search for the truth offers a strong hook. The connection between personal tragedy and the surrounding nightmare creates an intriguing reason to investigate.

coveredGames.name: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
coveredGames.title: Broken glasses, messy floors, impatient patrons, unwanted guests, and sudden fights keep everyone moving, making even a failed shift entertaining.

coveredGames.name: The Merlies
coveredGames.title: Environmental obstacles, hidden passages, and squad-based abilities create satisfying challenges without disturbing the game’s calm and comforting atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Protagonist’s improvised approach to survival remains extremely entertaining. Creating useful technology from scrap and duct tape makes every successful invention feel appropriately ridiculous.

coveredGames.name: Megastore Simulator
coveredGames.title: Starting with limited funds, choosing departments, filling shelves, and expanding the building creates a clear sense of progress.

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: Producing higher-grade goods feels genuinely worthwhile because quality opens better opportunities.

coveredGames.name: Throttle Trace
coveredGames.title: Throttle Trace offers an impressive amount of simulation beneath its simple controls. Pretty fun to enjoy some casual racing.

coveredGames.name: Himawari - The Sunflower -
coveredGames.title: Himawari - The Sunflower is a great choice of a romantic visual novel if you crave some slice of life + light mystery elements.

coveredGames.name: 33 Days till Extraction
coveredGames.title: Completely playable loop, varied weapons, cool abilities, base systems and strong atmosphere create a promising foundation.

coveredGames.name: Knuckle Jet
coveredGames.title: The jetpunk world, rocket-fist mechanics, customizable gear, hidden rewards, and cooperative chaos come together in a remarkably entertaining package.

coveredGames.name: The Swashbugglers
coveredGames.title: Recruit insect heroes, build formations and let them fight automatically. Hundreds of gear pieces and layered skill choices make this cartoon roguelike surprisingly deep.

coveredGames.name: Ghost Village Girl ~The Village in a Cage~
coveredGames.title: A mist-covered village that traps everyone inside is a strong horror setup. Explore Himeyoshi, uncover its folklore and find out why every attempt to escape fails. A very pleasant VN.

coveredGames.name: Magical Blush
coveredGames.title: A very cozy and highly entertaining top-down action-adventure game with cool pixel graphics and amazing gameplay, that will appeal to all genre fans. Don't think twice and just try it!

coveredGames.name: Deliria
coveredGames.title: Different weapons, magic options, companions, terrain tools, and multiplayer settings let players shape both their character and their adventures.

coveredGames.name: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
coveredGames.title: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is perfect for players who enjoy cleanup simulators, hid den-object challenges, and cozy cooperation.

coveredGames.name: Da Capo 3 R
coveredGames.title: Da Capo 3 R offers an engaging blend of romance, humor and storytelling. Return to Hatsune Island, where cherry blossoms bloom endlessly and unexpected mysteries await.

coveredGames.name: Animal Falling
coveredGames.title: Animal Falling seems designed for immediate fun, but the trap combinations and movement mechanics offer room for mastery.

coveredGames.name: Lady Death Demonicron
coveredGames.title: Fans of gothic fantasy will appreciate Lady Death Demonicron detailed environments and sinister creature designs.

coveredGames.name: Drone Sector
coveredGames.title: Great balance between arcade action and tactical planning. Drone Sector is easy to start playing, but the squad and resource systems give it lasting appeal.

coveredGames.name: Liquidation RTS
coveredGames.title: Visually rich and mechanically polished, Liquidation blends fantasy magic with sci-fi tech in spectacular fashion.

coveredGames.name: Resort Island Simulator
coveredGames.title: Resort Island Simulator looks like a refreshing blend of management, survival, exploration, and trading.

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: Angels Fall First creates a battlefield where infantry soldiers, pilots, boarding teams, and commanders all have valuable responsibilities.

coveredGames.name: The Dream Office
coveredGames.title: Its a simple idea with considerable charm and simulation potential. Together, they give The Dream Office a distinctive, welcoming concept.

coveredGames.name: Nerd Simulator
coveredGames.title: The combination of management, puzzles, role-playing elements, and customization creates a varied experience with a distinctive comedic voice.

coveredGames.name: DREADHOLM
coveredGames.title: Adjustable difficulty, distinct party roles, and readable boss mechanics make them enjoyable goals for friends who want structured challenges together.

coveredGames.name: Frog Island
coveredGames.title: Frog Island offers a wonderfully cozy blend of creature collecting, farming, fishing, exploration, and decorating.

coveredGames.name: SWAT Commander
coveredGames.title: Planning, communication, and disciplined execution make each mission feel rewarding, especially when your squad moves smoothly through dangerous situations.

coveredGames.name: Laundering Simulator - Clean Cash and Laundry
coveredGames.title: Managing machines, supplies, customers, and prices becomes surprisingly immersive, especially with the game’s weird and funny narrative.

coveredGames.name: Stellar Warfare
coveredGames.title: Campaign missions, skirmishes, cooperative wave defense, and competitive multiplayer provide plenty of ways to test different fleets and tactical approaches.

coveredGames.name: Pool of Madness
coveredGames.title: The basic idea is simple: sink the green balls before the turns run out. Red balls cost sanity, so every shot needs some thought. Strange table effects keep the matches fun and a little unpredictable.

coveredGames.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
coveredGames.title: The research facility feels wonderfully hostile when every noise might attract something dangerous. Sneaking through its sectors with a clumsy crew creates a great balance of dread and comedy.

coveredGames.name: Zombie Hamsters
coveredGames.title: The game is easy to understand: explore the lab, avoid dangerous enemies, and work together to escape. Finding the right path takes some trial and error, but the funny moments make it enjoyable.

coveredGames.name: Hypernet Explorer
coveredGames.title: Few sandboxes attempt to connect politics, personal lives, magic, and cosmic travel on this scale. The unpredictable interactions and offbeat atmosphere make experimentation its biggest attraction.

coveredGames.name: Wielders of the Essence
coveredGames.title: The short runs are packed with action, and upgrading the settlement after each battle feels rewarding. Unlocking new troops and spells gives a good reason to return and try different combinations.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: The open world is beautiful and rewards exploration with hidden quests, treasures, and underwater areas. Finding useful upgrades away from the main story makes traveling across Auroria enjoyable.

coveredGames.name: Clogwork
coveredGames.title: The campaign has a nice progression from basic shapes to complicated multicolored designs. There is no time pressure, and the workshop plus custom puzzles provide lots of ways to keep experimenting.

coveredGames.name: Gas N Cars
coveredGames.title: The gas station jobs are simple but really fun. Filling tanks to the exact amount, cleaning dirty cars, and fixing broken parts give each customer a different task and keep every shift interesting.

coveredGames.name: I Know a Spot
coveredGames.title: Choosing a car, changing its colors and wheels, and finding a scenic place to park is a fun little routine. Setting up a camp beside a lake or in the forest makes each location feel personal.

coveredGames.name: Boku Boku
coveredGames.title: The little details make this sandbox enjoyable. Animals can be ridden, instruments can be played, and toys have working minigames. There is always something fun to try between building projects.

coveredGames.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
coveredGames.title: Retla is a charming main character, with great animations and fun voice lines. The anime style looks good in motion, and the quick arena battles make this an enjoyable game for short sessions.

coveredGames.name: Beyond The Evil
coveredGames.title: A village that changes its layout while being explored is an unsettling detour. Familiar streets suddenly stop making sense, creating a memorable moment of psychological unease without combat.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: Designing the stadium, club grounds and even seating patterns gives long careers a strong sense of ownership. Watching those facilities grow alongside the team makes success feel wonderfully tangible.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: Light becomes more than illumination here: it gives weight, shape and gravity to shadows. Watching a flat outline become a staircase or pillar makes every solved room feel like a small act of magic.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: Watching ingredients swirl into a glowing vessel gives card combinations a touch of magic. Animated spells and opening portals make this digital tabletop adventure feel wonderfully alive and colorful.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Mechanical salads and glowing energy drinks give the menu a wonderfully bizarre personality. The hands-on preparation makes each strange order feel like a tiny arcade challenge instead of busywork

coveredGames.name: Golf 5 MAX
coveredGames.title: This is the kind of sports game that makes sense within minutes. Pick a character, enjoy the bright scenery and try to beat the last score. The playful arcade atmosphere keeps things light and fun.

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies
coveredGames.title: There is charm in watching a bare patch of woodland become a comfortable retreat through patient work. Handmade decorations and carefully chosen details make the space feel like it belongs to you.

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles
coveredGames.title: Quick dashes and attack mix-ups make fighting more expressive than its simple controls suggest. Learning when to dodge, punish and unleash a special turns frantic enemy waves into a rewarding dance.

coveredGames.name: Thunder Hoop Collection (QUByte Classics)
coveredGames.title: Fireballs, lasers and spectacular phoenix attacks bring that glorious 1990s excess to life. The sequel fills its detailed sci-fi backdrops with enough chaos to keep reflexes working overtime.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Classic Rush is a fantastic nostalgia hit, while Hero Party and Blitz completely change the rhythm of familiar stages. Five modes per map give the campaign far more replay value than expected.

coveredGames.name: Realm of Taiwu
coveredGames.title: Common loot can quickly become legendary gear, and the steady power curve makes each run feel rewarding. Elixirs, equipment bonuses and varied builds give the monster-slaying grind plenty of momentum.

coveredGames.name: 4 Penny Coffins
coveredGames.title: Different investigator roles give teamwork real purpose instead of turning every round into pure guessing. Police track fingerprints, doctors study blood, and every clue can expose a convincing liar.

coveredGames.name: Rooster
coveredGames.title: An apology basket for Rat is a wonderfully gentle way to begin, mixing hidden-object searching with humor and cultural detail. The hand-painted scenes make even small acts of kindness feel memorable.

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls
coveredGames.title: Six romances, time rewinds and fatal mistakes give this FMV more bite than a standard dating sim. Strong acting, polished 4K scenes and an emotional final stretch make the journey memorable.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Starting with paperwork and case files, then growing into patrols and dispatch work, gives the station a rewarding sense of progress. Each upgrade makes the job feel broader, busier and more alive.

coveredGames.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
coveredGames.title: Restoring a shattered museum piece by piece is deeply satisfying as empty halls come back to life. Searching, matching fragments and unlocking tools keeps the whole cleanup relaxing and rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Scavland
coveredGames.title: Scavland makes survival feel wonderfully deliberate. Limited ammunition, dangerous expeditions, faction politics, and customizable weapons turn every journey into a balance between greed and caution.

coveredGames.name: Tormentum II
coveredGames.title: Beautifully disturbing artwork, excellent music, and a fascinating simulation mystery create a gripping experience. The puzzles flow naturally, and multiple endings make each choice feel important.

coveredGames.name: Chop Chop Together
coveredGames.title: Warehouse duty has a knack for turning one misplaced parcel into a full-blown team emergency. Sorting, packing and shipping under pressure makes the smallest successful delivery feel triumphant.

coveredGames.name: Dark Farts: Parody Smell Edition
coveredGames.title: Managing the gas meter gives all the nonsense a mischievous twist, with choices leading toward multiple endings. This cheeky, compact spoof commits to its ridiculous premise from start to finish.

coveredGames.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
coveredGames.title: A handmade design on display, a new tattoo machine and another satisfied customer make progress easy to see. Staff and studio upgrades turn a modest shop into a cheerful little business empire.

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: From dusty extraction points to sparkling gemstones, the production chain feels rewarding to build. Better machines, cleaner workflows and higher throughput create a wonderfully addictive rhythm.

coveredGames.name: Gravebound
coveredGames.title: Gravebound turns post-apocalyptic survival into wonderfully absurd co-op chaos. Fighting weaponized appliances, combining powerful upgrades, and escaping with your loot gives every run real momentum.

coveredGames.name: Brave New Wonders
coveredGames.title: The factory-building loop feels refreshingly different when robots follow your instructions. Optimizing production, linking systems, and watching the world come to life makes progress compelling.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Harsh space survival is softened by absurd humor, junk and an immortal chicken. Exploring dangerous ruins, upgrading gear and solving problems with duct tape gives the adventure plenty of charm.

coveredGames.name: Hot Rod Mayhem
coveredGames.title: Each championship mixes races with skill trials, so the campaign rarely feels repetitive. Boosters, hazards and power-ups keep the pace high, while varied cars make every cup feel a little different.

coveredGames.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows
coveredGames.title: Combat rewards careful planning without drowning everything in random chance. Gear, squad roles and environmental tricks create satisfying battles, while branching decisions give the campaign weight.

coveredGames.name: Dread Admiral
coveredGames.title: Every lost vessel leaves a scar on the campaign, making cautious advances and desperate retreats equally meaningful. Distinct admirals and shifting missions keep each voyage tense and fresh.

coveredGames.name: Magical Blush
coveredGames.title: Fast spellcasting, lovely pixel art and mystical music give the adventure an easy charm. Secrets, talismans and new abilities make old areas worth revisiting long after the first journey through.

coveredGames.name: System Arrival
coveredGames.title: Ruined-city raids feed a layered bunker sim: bring back supplies, recruit survivors, research monster DNA and turn a fragile shelter into a defended home. Psychic powers spice up the fights.

coveredGames.name: Me and You
coveredGames.title: Turning words into rules gives this co-op puzzler its clever hook: move scraps, rocks and walls to reshape each level. The best moments come when a partner spots a rule you both missed.

coveredGames.name: Etranger In the City of Doom
coveredGames.title: Grid-based dungeons turn every key, item and enemy into a resource puzzle, rewarding careful planning over quick reflexes. Tio's journey adds a darker fantasy story and a close-knit cast.

coveredGames.name: Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon
coveredGames.title: A quirky trio of adventurers makes this dungeon crawl more than a routine loot hunt. Explore winding rooms, battle monsters, appraise ancient relics and turn each expedition into steady progress.

coveredGames.name: Cat Squeeze
coveredGames.title: An explosive kitten, cramped pipes and carefully placed boxes turn each maze into a neat spatial puzzle. Hand-drawn worlds keep the journey charming, while new mechanics refresh each region.

coveredGames.name: Car Flipper
coveredGames.title: From dusty auction finds to late-night pink-slip races, there's more here than flipping cars for cash. Early Access still has rough edges, but inspecting, repairing and selling feels rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Clandestined: Fade to Gray
coveredGames.title: Physical, mental and emotional checks add a welcome layer to this visual novel, making character choices matter beyond dialogue. The mystery of the missing brother gives the lab a darker edge.

coveredGames.name: Boss in Diapers
coveredGames.title: Bluffing, risky offers and quick-fire party modes give this daycare brawl a lively social hook. The baby-mafia costumes add charm, though its small player count makes a full lobby essential.

coveredGames.name: Pre-Warp Age
coveredGames.title: Building a spacefaring civilization feels wonderfully methodical here. Chart unknown worlds, nurture distant colonies and research new technologies, all in pursuit of that first leap between stars.

coveredGames.name: Monkeys!¡
coveredGames.title: High-tempo school comedy thrives on the clash between Saruyoshi's rough edges and the refined world he's trying to infiltrate. The cast's eccentric chemistry keeps every awkward encounter lively.

coveredGames.name: Net Worthless
coveredGames.title: A sharp little economy of choices, where forgotten subscriptions sting and the stock market tempts with easy riches. Planning each month becomes a wry battle against bills, inflation and yourself.

coveredGames.name: Moomin: Midsummer Madness
coveredGames.title: Floodwaters turn Moominvalley into a storybook voyage, with hand-painted scenes, familiar faces and gentle point-and-click puzzles. Switching between Moomintroll and Little My adds a playful spark.

coveredGames.name: The Maker Way
coveredGames.title: Designing machines from parts, 3D-printing creations and commanding a fleet makes engineering hands-on. Exploration, outposts and robot encounters give this sandbox a satisfying sense of purpose.

coveredGames.name: Supermarket Organizer
coveredGames.title: There’s a quiet pleasure in turning bare konbinis into welcoming little shops. Unboxing treats, fitting out shelves and finding a place for every item make this a soothing exercise in order.

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies
coveredGames.title: A peaceful wilderness retreat swaps harsh survival for cabin building, home-grown meals and wildlife photography. Its unhurried loop celebrates small wins and makes outdoor time restorative.

coveredGames.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
coveredGames.title: A desktop fishing retreat pairs gentle collecting with adorable cats, custom outfits and unlockable scenery. Its idle pace invites quick visits, while shared fishing and trading add a social touch.

coveredGames.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
coveredGames.title: A runaway escape through a vlogger's world sets the stage for tense pursuits, quick decisions and unexpected turns. Its contemporary premise adds personality, while the chase keeps momentum high.

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles
coveredGames.title: Sharp timing and decisive encounters put combat at the heart of this action adventure. Learning enemy patterns makes hard-won victories satisfying, while the brisk pace keeps every clash engaging.

coveredGames.name: Truth Beneath the Shadows
coveredGames.title: Clues and uneasy discoveries draw players into a shadowy mystery. The gradual unravelling of hidden truths gives the story an intriguing pull, while its atmosphere keeps curiosity alive throughout.

coveredGames.name: ROLLA
coveredGames.title: A grotesque rolling menace turns the city into an arcade playground of destruction, survival and score chasing. Its bizarre premise and punchy action give every run a wonderfully chaotic edge.

coveredGames.name: BloomTale
coveredGames.title: Arranging flowers, tending a shop and fulfilling customers' ideas create a gentle creative loop. A magical setting and relaxed pace turn everyday business into a colourful ritual worth returning to.

coveredGames.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
coveredGames.title: An alternate-history Kyiv, grotesque foes and retrofuturist weapons give this shooter a striking identity. Modern fixes smooth its rough edges without losing the eerie appeal of a cult classic.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Space survival gains a comic voice through scavenging, tool crafting and cosmic trouble. Exploring, building and improvising alongside an immortal chicken give this adventure a distinctive spark.

coveredGames.name: Hypernet Explorer
coveredGames.title: A post-Y2K European setting blends roguelike structure with an offbeat immersive-sim sensibility. Its unusual atmosphere and genre-mixing ambition promise a distinctive journey for curious players.

coveredGames.name: Good Job : Night Hustle Simulator
coveredGames.title: A shady night business becomes a playground for absurd decisions, demanding customers and dark comedy. Staff, appointments, deliveries and expansion give the outrageous premise a strategic backbone.

coveredGames.name: THE DEAD WE KNEW: Open World Survival
coveredGames.title: Abandoned sites, scarce supplies and danger set the stage for open-world survival. Scavenging, shelter building and co-op play offer a compelling way to face the infected and hostile survivors.

coveredGames.name: Anonymous Hacker Simulator
coveredGames.title: Digital clues, complex systems and careful plans give this hacking adventure a satisfying rhythm. Its investigative tasks should delight fans of technological thrillers and methodical problem-solving.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: Alchemy is a race of clever recipes and sharper tactics. Gather ingredients, chain potions, cast spells and outmaneuver rivals on shifting boards in this richly layered tabletop strategy game.

coveredGames.name: WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027
coveredGames.title: A deep managerial sandbox where tactics, club growth and long-term planning shape each season. Many playable nations and creative tools make building a football world absorbing and personal.

coveredGames.name: Would You Love Me If I Was a Snake?
coveredGames.title: An unusual premise balances absurd humour with a surprisingly tender question. Its quirky spirit and heartfelt undertone give this playful adventure a charm that lingers long after the final moment.

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls
coveredGames.title: A warm romance of distinct personalities and delicate turns of affection. Thoughtful conversations and meaningful choices let each connection unfold naturally, making the cast easy to cherish.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Varied lanes, memorable enemy waves and a rich mix of towers, heroes and spells keep battles engaging. Careful timing, smart upgrades and creative defenses make each hard-won victory satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Rise of the Merchants
coveredGames.title: More than a town builder, this medieval economy sim ties production and caravan logistics to diplomacy, politics and optional PvP. Its online world gives every growing city wider stakes.

coveredGames.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator
coveredGames.title: Building an empire here starts with pocket change and a lemonade stand, then branches into vending machines, side hustles and home upgrades. Casual minigames keep the sunny grind varied.

coveredGames.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
coveredGames.title: Two vampires, five rival factions and a city balanced on the edge of a knife. Shape Berlin's underworld through political gambits, branching dialogue and forbidden blood alchemy at night.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: Part Portal-like brainteaser, part surreal mystery, this puzzle adventure makes light your main tool. Rotate, merge and resize objects across intricate stages while an odd administrator watches.

coveredGames.name: UBAI Ending
coveredGames.title: Corporate secrets surface when a mysterious executive confronts Ryousuke with an ultimatum. A character-driven visual novel focused on difficult decisions, hidden motives and emotional fallout.

coveredGames.name: False Myth 2
coveredGames.title: Stealth strikes, spectacular magic and coordinated partner attacks give this sequel a livelier combat rhythm. Between dungeon crawls and mini-games, a sprawling romance-driven story unfolds.

coveredGames.name: Space Savory
coveredGames.title: Forget farm-to-table: this intergalactic kitchen takes its ingredients directly from the customers. A darkly comic blend of cooking challenges, inventory juggling and shady space-side business.

coveredGames.name: CRACK
coveredGames.title: One giant egg, a mysterious lab and an absurdly satisfying work shift. Team up, smash through layers, upgrade your tools and uncover what lies beneath the shell. Weirdly addictive co-op fun!

coveredGames.name: ZED ZONE
coveredGames.title: Scavenge materials, craft gear, and upgrade skills while battling relentless zombie hordes and strange mechs. Build shelters solo or team up in co-op for intense, rewarding survival action.

coveredGames.name: Bee Island
coveredGames.title: Build, research, defend, repeat: this loop hooks fast. Guard your queen, upgrade defenses, unleash nukes if needed. Solo or co-op, the hive always demands one more wave.

coveredGames.name: Saborus
coveredGames.title: Dread creeps in as you guide a frightened chicken through a slaughterhouse built on panic. Every puzzle tightens your chest, every chase leaves your nerves raw and lingering.

coveredGames.name: ROMUL
coveredGames.title: Explore, photograph, extract, repeat - ROMUL's loop hooks you fast. Unstable gravity and lurking monsters keep every co-op run with your AI partner tense and unpredictable.

coveredGames.name: Regiments
coveredGames.title: Heliborne infantry steal the show, reshaping battlefield tactics entirely. Command French, Dutch, Canadian, or Czechoslovakian regiments through unpredictable, procedurally-generated Operations.

coveredGames.name: DROP - System Breach
coveredGames.title: DROP stands out by blending stealth, strategy, and sharp action into tense hacking runs, as you maneuver between rival corporations battling for fragmented city networks.

coveredGames.name: ASPIS
coveredGames.title: Grief and dread intertwine in ASPIS. Chasing a lost family through a decaying Soviet institute, longing curdles into terror as reality fractures, first-person and deeply unsettling.

coveredGames.name: Legendary Pilots
coveredGames.title: Climbing from rookie routes to a thriving airline career feels genuinely rewarding, as you manage passengers, maintain planes, and expand your pixel-art empire step by step.

coveredGames.name: MARS 2120
coveredGames.title: Mars feels desolate yet alive here, moody corridors steeped in mystery and tension. Blending fluid melee and ranged combat, this metroidvania pulls you into Anna's haunting journey with style.

coveredGames.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
coveredGames.title: Zipping through Hunter Haven with your Lasso feels exhilarating, blending chaotic co-op teamwork with the bittersweet tension of knowing friendships end when the bounty falls.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: Auroria pulls you in with wonder, then grips your heart through fierce PvP battles and shared adventures. Every victory and loss with friends feels genuinely meaningful here.

coveredGames.name: Deck & Conn
coveredGames.title: Retro pixel art drenched in Cold War dread, Deck & Conn nails a tense, claustrophobic mood aboard your nuclear corvette. Strategy and atmosphere fuse beautifully here.

coveredGames.name: Adore
coveredGames.title: Collect unique creatures, assemble your ideal team, and dive into fast-paced action battles as you chase the legendary God of the Creatures across this gripping solo RPG journey.

coveredGames.name: ATOM RPG: Post-apocalyptic indie game
coveredGames.title: Where Fallout's wasteland meets Baldur's Gate depth, ATOM RPG carves its own niche with rich co-op options and deep classic CRPG mechanics rarely paired together so well.

coveredGames.name: Duelist: Idle Expedition
coveredGames.title: Perfect for busy strategists who crave progress without constant attention. Recruit 90+ pixel heroes, automate battles, and watch your camp conquer the Continent while you work.

coveredGames.name: Throttle Trace
coveredGames.title: Throttle Trace blends slot-car nostalgia with real simulation tension, demanding pure throttle and brake mastery. Every corner feels tense, immersive, and gripping from start to finish.

coveredGames.name: Rage of the Dragons NEO
coveredGames.title: Tag team mechanics give these fights real depth, swapping fighters mid-combo keeps matches fast and unpredictable. Online PvP and full controller support make every round genuinely satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Yandere Virus
coveredGames.title: Gather Platonic Pumpkins solo or with three friends in frantic online co-op runs. Full controller support adds comfort while tension builds, making every rescue attempt genuinely thrilling.

coveredGames.name: Sea Power : Naval Combat in the Missile Age
coveredGames.title: Command NATO or Warsaw Pact forces, managing weapons and sensors under strict rules of engagement. Tense campaigns reward sharp tactics and timing, delivering gripping naval combat.

coveredGames.name: Beat 'Em Up Collection (QUByte Classics)
coveredGames.title: Seven classic brawlers packed with punchy, satisfying combat, rewind saves, and handy cheats for extra fun. Split-screen co-op makes every street fight a blast with friends!

coveredGames.name: Blades & Battles
coveredGames.title: Swing swords as Arthur or Lancelot, smashing through retro-inspired 2.5D battles. The co-op loop of slashing enemies and surviving waves keeps every session addictive.

coveredGames.name: Task Force Admiral - Vol.1: American Carrier Battles
coveredGames.title: Commanding carriers through the Pacific feels genuinely earned. Every tactical decision builds toward mastery, from first-person deck views to god's-eye fleet command, this is the real masterpiece!

coveredGames.name: Battlefield Commander WWII
coveredGames.title: Command hundreds of distinct WWII units across real-time battles. The tactical depth in managing soldiers and vehicles simultaneously makes every engagement feel fresh and satisfying.

coveredGames.name: Dying Breed
coveredGames.title: Gritty nostalgia hits hard here: campy FMV cutscenes, pounding electro-metal, and desperate zombie skirmishes create a thrilling, nerve-wracking throwback that genuinely stirs old-school adrenaline.

coveredGames.name: Rise of Piracy
coveredGames.title: From a single modest ship to commanding a feared fleet, every victory feels earned. Trading, battling and recruiting build real momentum toward true pirate glory.

coveredGames.name: Car Park Capital
coveredGames.title: Strategy fans who enjoy morally dubious city planning will savor this one. Design car parks, spread propaganda, and outsmart resistant townsfolk in this clever simulation.

coveredGames.name: Better Than Dead
coveredGames.title: Fans of visceral, close-quarters bodycam shooters will love this Hong Kong revenge saga - mastering bullet time and rhythm-based combat rewards precision, speed, and relentless replay-driven mayhem.

coveredGames.name: Sword & Siege Age of Longbow: Volume I
coveredGames.title: With 94 scenarios and sweeping campaigns, this tactical wargame stands apart through sheer depth, letting longbow tactics and sieges unfold patiently across the Hundred Years War.

coveredGames.name: Great Northern War
coveredGames.title: A frozen, atmospheric Baltic theater unfolds across 89 scenarios - shifting alliances, winter campaigns, and tense tactical command create immersive northern war drama worth savoring slowly.

coveredGames.name: Thirty Years War
coveredGames.title: Eighty scenarios across two sprawling campaigns make this tactical wargame a dream for history buffs seeking authentic 17th-century warfare and deep strategic command.

coveredGames.name: DRAPLINE
coveredGames.title: A cozy yet fierce atmosphere surrounds this dragon-raising journey, blending warmth and tension beautifully across one fateful year of growth and looming catastrophe.

coveredGames.name: The Crust
coveredGames.title: Isolation, pride, and quiet dread blend beautifully here. Every drone route and colonist decision feels weighty, turning lunar survival into a deeply personal, emotional journey.

coveredGames.name: Journey of Realm：Dawn Dew
coveredGames.title: Explore as Dew across a grid-like realm, gathering combat styles while pushing back the black beast tide. The strategic turn-based loop and mounting threats make each run worth replaying.

coveredGames.name: Liquidation RTS
coveredGames.title: Command armies across Veá's battlefields, blending sci-fi tech with fantasy magic. Fighting over Quenrium demands sharp tactics, adaptable abilities, and constant strategic thinking in PvP clashes.

coveredGames.name: Warped Reality
coveredGames.title: Neon-drenched dread and glitching virtual worlds create a haunting cyberpunk mood. Every choice feels heavy, every ally uncertain. Immersive, tense, and beautifully bleak.

coveredGames.name: Fantasy Network
coveredGames.title: Umbrella-based combat is the star here - wildly satisfying against talent-show bosses! Explore Holua's colorful world where Likes equal power. A clever, charming metroidvania worth playing.

coveredGames.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
coveredGames.title: Ideal for strategists who value narrative and kinship over conquest. Guiding a caravan through the Bronze Age's collapse feels personal, tense, and deeply rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Repterra
coveredGames.title: Base-building meets dino chaos: manage your colony, breed and ride dinosaurs, then unleash them against relentless hordes. Deep, rewarding strategy with real teeth behind it.

coveredGames.name: HELLBOUND INC
coveredGames.title: Undead courier versus corporate hell: this precision platformer nails brutal timing challenges as you dodge demons, dodge HR, and deliver packages against the clock.

coveredGames.name: Sword & Siege Crusades: Book I
coveredGames.title: Dust, steel, and faith collide across 74 tense scenarios. Sieges feel brutal, frontier skirmishes tense - this tactical crusade saga immerses you completely in medieval warfare's grim atmosphere.

coveredGames.name: Woman Simulator
coveredGames.title: You roleplay as a housewife doing women's tasks.

coveredGames.name: Swords & Slippers
coveredGames.title: The game presents good-looking women and the devs simply declared the wokies aren't their targeted audiences.

coveredGames.name: Mistfall Hunter
coveredGames.title: Uses body types in character creation.

coveredGames.name: Camelot Unchained
coveredGames.title: Says 1 and 2 instead of male and female in the character creation.

coveredGames.name: Crimson Desert Enhanced
coveredGames.title: The devs said they will reverse the censorship.

coveredGames.name: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis
coveredGames.title: Woke localizer butchered the English translations, added Reddit slangs and woke ideologies. The Japanese developers quickly fixed most of the translations (likely with a new translator).

coveredGames.name: PRAGMATA
coveredGames.title: Good gameplay, good graphics, good optimizations. No political agenda.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil 3 Nemesis (1999)
coveredGames.title: They intentionally used an alternate outfit of Jill that's covering up her body, for the screenshots on the store page. It doesn't affect the game since you can change outfits, but Capcom is lame.

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: While Grace was designed to be bland and not attractive, she's the opposite of the girlboss trend and brought back the damsel female character trope.

coveredGames.name: Where Winds Meet
coveredGames.title: Uses Body Type 1-2 in character creation. This only affects the English language (and probably some other western localizations).

coveredGames.name: SHUTEN ORDER
coveredGames.title: The game initially released with translation errors that messed up pronouns and could be perceived as if the game featured trans narrative. The Japanese devs ordered the localizers to fix the scripts.

coveredGames.name: Digimon Story Time Stranger
coveredGames.title: Use Type A and Type B instead of male and female.

coveredGames.name: SHRED A BILLION
coveredGames.title: Weirdly relaxing yet super hype when upgrades kick in! Feeding endless stacks of cash into the shredder hits every incremental sweet spot. Awesome first-person twist on number-go-down fun.

coveredGames.name: Zombies Aren't Real
coveredGames.title: The game is in early access. It's playable, and you can even enjoy it. This game has potential: if the developer takes on this project, it would be amazing.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: I can't stop playing ArcheAge Chronicles! The vibrant world of Auroria is a feast for the eyes, and the exciting action keeps the adrenaline pumping. It’s welcoming, deep, and endlessly engaging

coveredGames.name: CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife
coveredGames.title: A fairly enjoyable game with a good background soundtrack. It takes about 15 hours to complete on a leisurely mode, and another 2-3 hours to complete all 100% of the achievements.

coveredGames.name: Graveyard Keeper 2
coveredGames.title: I definitely like the second part of the game more than the first one so far. Everything is more convenient here, and there's a bit less grinding. Talents and strategic battles have been added.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: The tactical depth here is amazing! Balancing budget constraints with citywide emergency responses keeps every shift exciting. Highly satisfying progression system!

coveredGames.name: Hobby Horse
coveredGames.title: In this game, you'll have a blast riding your horse. I definitely recommend playing this game! It's so relaxing!

coveredGames.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check
coveredGames.title: This is one of the best games for me! It's a great game. Detailed, good gameplay and story. There are two modes: story mode and endless. The game itself is addictive and very good at it.

coveredGames.name: RIFTSTORM
coveredGames.title: This is a cooperative isometric looter-shooter with extraction elements. Players, as operatives, destroy hordes of monsters, collect loot and upgrade weapons. Dynamic, stylish and exciting!

coveredGames.name: Wild West Miner Simulator
coveredGames.title: An atmospheric Wild West survival and construction simulator. Extract resources, build a city, defend yourself from bandits and go from rags to riches.

coveredGames.name: Tales of ARISE
coveredGames.title: Journey into the mysterious world of Tales of Arise with the main character and her companion, fight numerous enemies, defeat the ruler of this world, and free him!

coveredGames.name: No Rest for the Wicked
coveredGames.title: A blend of gripping RPG action and a dark atmosphere. A thrilling adventure on the island of Sacra, where not only a deadly plague awaits you, but also the intrigues of the royal court.

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake
coveredGames.title: A remake of the cult third-person RPG Gothic. The game takes place in a gloomy world shrouded in a magical dome.

coveredGames.name: CarX Drift Racing Online 2
coveredGames.title: No predatory microtransactions here. You get what you pay for, and the base game is packed with content. It’s refreshing to see a modern racing game focus on gameplay over battle passes. Love it.

coveredGames.name: Table Battle Simulator
coveredGames.title: Table Battle Simulator nails the collector fantasy-opening boxes feels rewarding and the roster variety enables creative tactics. Running a shop adds pleasant management depth.

coveredGames.name: Monster Lab Simulator
coveredGames.title: Gorgeous creature variety and smart progression systems. I appreciated the clear tutorials and rewarding synthesis loop. Playing master of a chaotic lab never felt so thrilling!

coveredGames.name: Lords of Ravage
coveredGames.title: This is a strategy RPG where you take on the role of the final boss—the ruler of a dark empire seeking to reclaim its lost power. This game is your chance to become a legend among your enemies.

coveredGames.name: Office Simulator
coveredGames.title: From your very first day on the job, you'll encounter unexpected moments, unexpected tasks, and a wide variety of challenges that will test your ingenuity and ability to adapt.

coveredGames.name: Raiders of Blackveil
coveredGames.title: One of the best games out there, the character controls and combat are enjoyable. Flexible difficulty settings. Great game. Lots of options to create a unique build. Interesting characters.

coveredGames.name: Five Hearts Under One Roof season2
coveredGames.title: Five Hearts Under One Roof season 2 builds on a beautiful narrative. Yuman's charm and the diverse characters make every decision tough. A perfect mix of drama and romance awaits!

coveredGames.name: Lost But Found
coveredGames.title: The full version is very different from the demo—a ton of new items that you can interact with and level up in different ways, new upgrades, and more than one upgrade shop.

coveredGames.name: Concubine
coveredGames.title: Honestly, I didn't think I'd enjoy the game this much! The combat system feels surprisingly fluid, and the character customization is super detailed—I spent way too long customizing my character!

coveredGames.name: Deconstruction Simulator
coveredGames.title: A demolition simulator for all sorts of buildings and structures. It looks really well-made! The graphics and functionality are top-notch. I highly recommend buying the game and playing it!

coveredGames.name: Little Witch in the Woods
coveredGames.title: A very good and meditative game. You run around, collect plants, brew potions, solve puzzles. A cute pixel game. I recommend playing it!

coveredGames.name: Ratatan
coveredGames.title: The bustling island of Lada-Port is home to a group of strange and cheerful creatures. Set to upbeat music, they embark on a thrilling journey! Highly recommended!

coveredGames.name: Car Dealer Simulator
coveredGames.title: From finding deals to selling at the right time, every aspect feels rewarding. The game nails the thrill of the used car market perfectly.

coveredGames.name: Monster Mop Up
coveredGames.title: A fun game for all ages, which you can play with friends. You can also keep pets, everything is done cool here, so I recommend it!

coveredGames.name: Old Market Simulator
coveredGames.title: I've wanted to play a similar cozy store simulator for a long time, the game doesn't rush you anywhere and leaves you with plenty of time for development and learning the mechanics.

coveredGames.name: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
coveredGames.title: If you like quests with friends, this game is for you! The second game in the How 2 Escape series! I really liked the new theme of the game, as well as the puzzles that were offered in this game!

coveredGames.name: Let Them Trade
coveredGames.title: Let Them Trade offers a peaceful yet complex experience. Create a thriving kingdom at your own pace, trade wisely, and protect your towns from cheeky bandits. Beautifully crafted visuals.

coveredGames.name: Tiny Aquarium: Social Fishkeeping
coveredGames.title: I enjoyed spending time here! A good game, relaxing. We grow fish, feed them, keep them clean, breed them! There is a lot to do here, I recommend it!

coveredGames.name: Ship, Inc.
coveredGames.title: Not a bad, pleasant, simple game for a couple of hours. Here you can definitely relax and enjoy your work, I recommend! Need to support!

coveredGames.name: Tiny Pasture
coveredGames.title: Simply the cutest farm simulator on your taskbar! In just one day, I collected half of the local zoo! I liked this game because it takes little time and attention.

coveredGames.name: Fuel Harvest Together
coveredGames.title: Interesting game, game to just relax and play. Definitely recommend. I play again and again, and I like everything, so you too support!

coveredGames.name: Rogue: Genesia
coveredGames.title: I'm commenting as someone who finished Vampire Survivors. This game has better graphics, more variety, and a longer playtime than Vampire Survivors. I recommend getting it.

coveredGames.name: Bank Simulator
coveredGames.title: In this game, you will have to design and develop your own bank - from recruiting qualified personnel and issuing loans to investing in bonds.

coveredGames.name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
coveredGames.title: The game is very cool and beautiful stylized nice graphics and cool controls! This is a great game that is nice to play with friends, of course I recommend it!

coveredGames.name: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler
coveredGames.title: Lead a secret mercenary corporation: analyze intelligence, select squad composition and equipment, make tough decisions in a world where betrayal is commonplace.

coveredGames.name: Wielders of the Essence
coveredGames.title: The colorful graphics make the busy fights easy to enjoy, and the music fits the action nicely. There are not endless levels, but the steady upgrades and quick rounds make it a pleasant game to play.

coveredGames.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
coveredGames.title: Having four very different scientists makes cooperation more than just following friends down a hallway. Everyone needs help with something, and those small problems create plenty of funny situations.

coveredGames.name: Zombie Hamsters
coveredGames.title: Playing as tiny zombie hamsters makes exploring the laboratory quite funny. The main goal is to find an exit, but guards, robots, and strange rooms make teamwork important and every attempt different.

coveredGames.name: Hypernet Explorer
coveredGames.title: Traveling across a strange version of Europe is a nice change from dungeon crawling. Trains, towns, and side activities make the world worth exploring, even while some areas remain unfinished.

coveredGames.name: Pool of Madness
coveredGames.title: Each run mixes careful aiming with a bit of luck. Earning points, choosing upgrades, and trying to survive the next ritual makes the simple act of sinking balls much more engaging than expected.

coveredGames.name: Clogwork
coveredGames.title: Logic gates, sensors, and counters add a rewarding layer beyond conveyor management. Solving a stubborn bottleneck with a neat circuit delivers the real deep satisfaction automation fans crave.

coveredGames.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
coveredGames.title: There's a solid mix of solo exploration and group activities, including dungeons and challenging bosses. The buy-to-play approach without paid combat advantages is another welcome feature for an MMO.

coveredGames.name: Boku Boku
coveredGames.title: Creating custom blocks and connecting switches to lights adds a clever layer to the building. Even small projects feel satisfying when decorations can be personalized and rooms can respond to actions.

coveredGames.name: I Know a Spot
coveredGames.title: Rain, crackling fires, and changing daylight give the campsites a wonderfully calm atmosphere. With no timers or survival chores, the experience is all about slowing down and enjoying the outdoors.

coveredGames.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
coveredGames.title: The recipe system makes this card game surprisingly strategic. Combining simple ingredients into stronger potions is satisfying, and using an opponent's creations adds a fun competitive element.

coveredGames.name: Slotbound
coveredGames.title: The best part is deciding whether another spin is worth the gold. One small adjustment to the reels can change everything, so the slot machine feels more like a tactical gamble than blind luck.

coveredGames.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
coveredGames.title: Each stage feels handcrafted, with interactable scenery and enemy mixes that reward changing tactics instead of repeating one build. The result is classic tower defense with real strategic bite.

coveredGames.name: Order: The New Dawn
coveredGames.title: Trading adds a welcome layer beyond simply gathering resources. Deciding what to keep, what to sell and where to send a shipment gives the growing settlement a convincing place in a wider universe.

coveredGames.name: Make the Empire Great Again
coveredGames.title: Watching a settlement become a busy kingdom is satisfying, especially when every new building has a purpose. The blend of cozy planning and looming danger gives the whole adventure a lively rhythm.

coveredGames.name: Athanasia
coveredGames.title: Finding a route through the sprawling complex feels like a genuine achievement. Elevators, shortcuts and hidden rooms slowly turn a confusing maze into a place that rewards patience and curiosity.

coveredGames.name: Under Canopies
coveredGames.title: The way small errands grow into an afternoon adventure is oddly addictive. Setting out for supplies, spotting a curious animal and finding a new trail makes the world feel worth exploring slowly.

coveredGames.name: Golf 5 MAX
coveredGames.title: Friendly competition is the real attraction here. Each course offers fresh little obstacles, and improving a score feels surprisingly exciting. It turns a quiet sport into a lively arcade pastime.

coveredGames.name: Mix Universe
coveredGames.title: Mixing ingredients into unexpected creations gives this sandbox its own alchemical charm. The joy comes from stumbling upon surprising results and watching simple ideas spiral into something new.

coveredGames.name: Galvatein : Adventurers' Guild
coveredGames.title: Turning a ragtag band into a renowned adventurers' guild has a satisfying pull, with every recruit shaping the road to glory. The real joy is watching a humble outfit earn its legend.

coveredGames.name: Realm of Taiwu
coveredGames.title: An alternate Taiwu timeline gives the survivor formula real narrative flavor. Hunting ten divine swords across corrupted lands makes each run feel tied to a larger struggle instead of random grinding.

coveredGames.name: THANKS, LIGHT.
coveredGames.title: A clever first-person puzzle game where a flashlight turns flat shadows into real 3D objects. Stairs, cubes and pillars become tools for solving rooms, and later mechanics keep the idea fresh.

coveredGames.name: Carry The Count
coveredGames.title: The best co-op moments come from trying to help and somehow making everything worse. A missed grab, a broken coffin or a badly timed cannon shot can turn a simple crossing into pure co-op comedy.

coveredGames.name: Aquapark Tycoon
coveredGames.title: Co-op works remarkably well for a management game. Dividing tasks, expanding the park together, and solving guest problems as a team makes building ambitious resorts both relaxing and exciting.

coveredGames.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
coveredGames.title: Rebuilding a museum from scattered fragments has a wonderfully meditative rhythm. Ancient weapons, fossils and statues turn each room into a quiet puzzle, while visible progress makes it worthwhile.

coveredGames.name: Love All My Girls
coveredGames.title: Each heroine brings a distinct mood, from playful banter to heavier emotional turns. Slick live-action presentation and dozens of endings make the romance feel far richer than its premise suggests.

coveredGames.name: Rooster
coveredGames.title: The twelve-animal structure gives the adventure a lovely rhythm, with each friend bringing a new challenge. From matchmaking to babysitting, the surprises keep coming without losing the cozy tone.

coveredGames.name: Police Chief Simulator
coveredGames.title: Case reports, patrol work and station upgrades form a satisfying climb from small-town paperwork to real command. Hiring staff slowly transforms the empty building into a working department.

coveredGames.name: Hot Rod Mayhem
coveredGames.title: Boost pads, shields and homing attacks turn every race into cheerful chaos. The ten championships and their opening trials give the campaign a fun rhythm beyond simply chasing first place overall.

coveredGames.name: Dread Admiral
coveredGames.title: Building a fleet is satisfying because every vessel has a clear role and every mistake can hurt. Perks, technology and permanent flagship upgrades make setbacks feel useful instead of wasted.

coveredGames.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
coveredGames.title: Running a tiny studio means more than drawing on skin. Ink supplies, cleanliness, equipment and customer patience all need attention, and watching the business find its feet is quietly rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Jixo 5: Mask Parade Collector’s Edition
coveredGames.title: Collecting ornate masks turns each chapter into a charming souvenir hunt. The Collector's Cabinet and photo album make the gorgeous scenery and theatrical melodies worth revisiting long afterward.

coveredGames.name: SeaColony
coveredGames.title: From a bare platform, a warm little settlement slowly rises above the waves. Fishing, farming and passing traders bring calm, while winter and shortages keep every season quietly tense at sea.

coveredGames.name: Mineral Mining Simulator
coveredGames.title: The real treasure is not buried in the rock, but in a production line that finally runs smoothly. Mining, refining, automation and clever layouts blend into a satisfying management loop.

coveredGames.name: HackHub - Ultimate Hacker Simulator
coveredGames.title: Following clues through fake social media, emails, and network scans makes each job feel like actual detective work. The Linux-style desktop and terminal give the whole experience real character.

coveredGames.name: Breathedge 2
coveredGames.title: Abandoned stations feel rewarding to explore because almost every corner hides scrap, a blueprint or some absurd surprise. Survival pressure and steady upgrades keep the journey lively throughout.

coveredGames.name: Eslabong
coveredGames.title: Smart AI, deep squad building and a lively mercenary market turn every league into a story of risks and comebacks. With so many classes and skills, even a losing season can still feel rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
coveredGames.title: Being able to comfort, threaten, deceive, or pressure suspects makes conversations surprisingly flexible. Their changing trust and reactions give clue hunting a sense of unpredictability and depth.

coveredGames.name: Shadow Dungeon
coveredGames.title: The best moments arrive when a modest build suddenly clicks: one weapon changes a skill, another piece multiplies its effect, and a room full of monsters disappears beneath a storm of damage.

coveredGames.name: 日本事故物件監視協会3 -Japan Stigmatized Property-
coveredGames.title: The use of real Japanese locations gives the surveillance setup an extra creepy edge. Subtle object changes, hidden figures and night-vision anomalies make every camera check feel tense and rewarding.

coveredGames.name: Angels Fall First
coveredGames.title: Capital ships you can actually pilot, walk through and board are still a rare sight in games. Add solid gunfights, dogfights, vehicles and good AI, and battles constantly produce memorable moments.

coveredGames.name: SULFUR
coveredGames.title: Really fun mix of old-school FPS and roguelike elements. The gunplay feels great, the atmosphere is fantastic, and every run keeps things interesting. Definitely had a lot of fun with this one!

coveredGames.name: Phantom Blade Zero
coveredGames.title: I've had a blast with this one. The combat feels incredibly satisfying, the visuals are beautiful, and the boss fights are easily among the highlights. Exactly the kind of action game I love playing!

coveredGames.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
coveredGames.title: Really enjoyed the atmosphere and unusual setting. It has that old-school FPS feel, with plenty of creepy moments and a world that keeps you curious. Definitely worth playing!

coveredGames.name: Valor Mortis
coveredGames.title: Love the dark atmosphere and brutal combat. The mix of fast-paced action, challenging enemies, and creepy environments makes this one easy to get into. Definitely looking forward to more!

coveredGames.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™
