coveredGames.name: The Posthumous Investigation
coveredGames.title: Despite a botched English translation, The Posthumous Investigation is well put together and worth playing!

coveredGames.name: Origament: A Paper Adventure
coveredGames.title: Origament: A Paper Adventure is a well-thought-out game for the theme, with beautiful scenery that all ages can enjoy.

coveredGames.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
coveredGames.title: Cronos: The New Dawn excels in its environmental creativity and atmosphere. The gameplay, on the other hand, feels like a clone of Dead Space with nothing extra on offer.

coveredGames.name: HUNTDOWN: OVERTIME
coveredGames.title: HUNTDOWN: OVERTIME is an absolute cracker of a platformer game! It's fun, challenging and you’ll be coming back for more!

coveredGames.name: Disciples: Domination
coveredGames.title: Disciples: Domination is a very solid turn-based combat RPG. I was entertained for over 80 hours, a must try!

coveredGames.name: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire
coveredGames.title: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire is for me a serious contender for the game of the year 2026! It's a masterpiece. Cheese

coveredGames.name: Darwin's Paradox!
coveredGames.title: Darwin's Paradox has stunning visuals and animations, and it runs very well! It's short for the asking price and without much replayability!

coveredGames.name: Summer Adventurers: Mediterranean
coveredGames.title: Summer Adventurers: Mediterranean is a short hidden-object and puzzle game featuring real pictures. A few minor details decreased my gaming experience!

coveredGames.name: Pizza Slice
coveredGames.title: Mamma mia, where did I put the mozzarella and how do I cook the pizza? It's Pizza Slice caotico!

coveredGames.name: Grind Survivors
coveredGames.title: Grind Survivors has a fast gameplay and is really fun, but needs more content!

coveredGames.name: Deck of Haunts
coveredGames.title: Deck-building games are not my favourite genre, but Deck of Haunts won me over!

coveredGames.name: Resident Evil Requiem
coveredGames.title: Resident Evil Requiem: I waited patiently. I played it extensively, and I loved it immensely!

coveredGames.name: Super Woden: Rally Edge
coveredGames.title: Super Woden: Rally Edge is an amazing top-down arcade racing game! It's super fun, and for A$18.95, it's a no-brainer! Get it, you won't regret it!

coveredGames.name: I Hate This Place
coveredGames.title: I Hate This Place has great visuals and runs beautifully. It’s a bit short for the asking price and it needs to be more challenging.

coveredGames.name: Mafia: The Old Country
coveredGames.title: Mafia: The Old Country is a mix of amazing elements and missed opportunities, but far too short for what it is worth!

coveredGames.name: Valor Mortis
coveredGames.title: Dark Souls meets the Napoleonic Wars in this twisted alternate history. A robust, if linear, experience that marks its place fairly high in the soulslike genre.

coveredGames.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
coveredGames.title: A masterclass in job-based, turn-based combat and a story that, while often lackluster on its own, provides an incredible amount of depth for long-running fans of the franchise.

coveredGames.name: HYPER DEMON
coveredGames.title: Beneath an unbelievably hostile appearance lies one of the most flawlessly crafted shooters to date. HYPER DEMON takes perseverance to learn, but those who rise to the challenge are rewarded in kind.

coveredGames.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
coveredGames.title: Castlevania may no longer be the trailblazer it once was, but who said you have to be wildly different to be a very good time?

coveredGames.name: Metro Exodus
coveredGames.title: An intriguing evolution of the Metro formula with excellent gameplay and a well-paced story, undermined by discouraging technical issues.

coveredGames.name: Beyond These Stars
coveredGames.title: A unique citybuilder, Beyond These Stars forces players to consider the consequences of their building as they voyage through the stars.

coveredGames.name: Echo Weaver
coveredGames.title: Echo Weaver's time loop may not offer the strongest puzzles, but it makes for an incredibly unique and addictive metroidvania.

coveredGames.name: Fogpiercer
coveredGames.title: When you've seen as many deckbuilders as I have, they all start to bleed together a bit. Not Fogpiercer, with its many, many ways that make it excellent.

coveredGames.name: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
coveredGames.title: A lush and well-written game, there are nevertheless frustrations amidst these many hells.

coveredGames.name: SiN Reloaded
coveredGames.title: A cult classic remastered, warts and all.

coveredGames.name: Birth
coveredGames.title: A sweet and cosy game with just the right level of puzzling, paired with an excellent art style and wonderful music

coveredGames.name: CONSCRIPT: Director’s Cut
coveredGames.title: A survival horror game set during the First World War where the only monster is mankind's own aptitude for brutality. A brilliant showcase of the cruelty of war and the horrors it creates.

coveredGames.name: False Hero
coveredGames.title: Many a soulslike peddles their own brand of innovative combat and captivating lore, but few have quite a love for the little embellishments and magnificent flourishes.

coveredGames.name: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO
coveredGames.title: Growing out of the sheer shock value of its predecessor, Brazilian Drug Dealer Before 4 is a satisfying psychedelic romp that’s difficult to resist, despite its shortcomings.

coveredGames.name: Gothic 1 Remake
coveredGames.title: Yer granpappy's RPG, rebuilt for modern sensibilities, artfully walking the line between the expectations of the modern crowd and the timelessness of strong and unique game design.

coveredGames.name: Kernel Hearts
coveredGames.title: Fantastically fresh, Kernel Hearts combines many tried-and-true features of previously acclaimed roguelikes with strong bullet-hell elements, creating a great but sometimes slightly unfocused title.

coveredGames.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
coveredGames.title: It's a bit long, it's a bit uneven, but the latest Onimusha's defensive swordplay is some of the finest ever made.

coveredGames.name: Best Served Cold
coveredGames.title: While the story itself may move more slowly than I'd like, the story is arguably not the point. The point is the characters and the stories they tell.

coveredGames.name: Cellar Keeper
coveredGames.title: There are 2448 bottles of wine to sort.

coveredGames.name: DREDGE
coveredGames.title: A fun and seemingly-cozy fishing game with a dark underside.

coveredGames.name: Mortal Shell II
coveredGames.title: A considerably better look for Mortal Shell, but one far too bold for its own good.

coveredGames.name: The Outer Worlds 2
coveredGames.title: The writing is by far the best element of Outer Worlds 2, with a wry irreverent style making the game a delight. However, the story as a whole falls flat.

coveredGames.name: PLATONICA SPACE
coveredGames.title: Short and janky, but with a setting and identity to make up for it. PLATONICA SPACE is a fantastic experimental title, if you are willing to chew through a relatively slow and confusing introduction.

coveredGames.name: Rita
coveredGames.title: A delightful little word, Rita is a wonderful way to spend a few hours.

coveredGames.name: 007 First Light
coveredGames.title: IO Interactive’s latest is as good a blockbuster as they come, but rings a bit hollow with where the genre and the developer’s work stand today.

coveredGames.name: Rubinite
coveredGames.title: Rubinite is proof that the only thing you need to make a simple game great is a team of very clever people.

coveredGames.name: METRO Last Light Redux
coveredGames.title: A decent follow-up to the first game, with a handful of persistent problems.

coveredGames.name: Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call

coveredGames.name: Dinoblade
coveredGames.title: There are much, much better soulslikes out there than Dinoblade, but I'd wager few have quite so many cool dinosaurs with cool swords engaging in cool sword/dinosaur-related activities.

coveredGames.name: En Garde!
coveredGames.title: En Garde! features likable characters, a light-hearted, stylistic premise and setting, and gameplay that becomes increasingly frustrating and tedious.

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Aincrad

coveredGames.name: RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business

coveredGames.name: HUNTDOWN: OVERTIME

coveredGames.title: Silly driving game about making deliveries, except tons of stuff in the map is destructible! Get from A to B by any means necessary! Had great fun with this one - Greb

coveredGames.name: The Planet Crafter
coveredGames.title: Lovely chill game about terraforming planets & moons, was astounded at how many updates this game got over time & it's a fun time with friends if you want to bring life to planets together - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Look Outside
coveredGames.title: One of the best indie horror experiences out there, the less said about it the better. I could hardly believe this was an RPG maker game, they've done such amazing things with the engine! - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Aviassembly
coveredGames.title: Building your own planes from scratch in a cool editor to do missions! It's a lot of fun coming up with designs to fit multiple roles depending on what's needed - Greb

coveredGames.name: Blue Prince
coveredGames.title: very fun & satisfying at first, but the further in you get the more reliant you are on RNG to solve puzzles as you can't solve certain parts until the layout & items line up right - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Mars First Logistics
coveredGames.title: Build your own rovers brick by brick to fulfill different jobs! Great vehicle editor, but missions can get a little repetitive toward the mid-late game - Greb

coveredGames.name: Coral Island
coveredGames.title: Some games I'd call "Stardew-like" but this is Stardews 3d twin separated at birth with identical mechanics. Some things it does do better, but it's difficult to not make constant comparisons - Iggy

coveredGames.name: Kiosk
coveredGames.title: Short horror game, good vibes though a little reliant on jumpscares when I'm trying to make burgers here! - Greb

coveredGames.name: 10 Second Mixtape
coveredGames.title: I dont know ANYTHING when it comes to making music but this gives you SUPER SIMPLIFED beats and just asks you to "match" the tapes that you think sound good together. share you tapes with everyone!!!!

coveredGames.name: Golden Swirl
coveredGames.title: FINALLY a deck builder that makes you have to think on your feet! the cards you pick matter when it comes to passing checks, positioning matters!!!

coveredGames.name: Bunderkin: The Ocular Eclipse
coveredGames.title: a cute little game with a main character that the NPCs dont like leading to our cocky protag to dawn a festival mask and stealthy creep around helping the people of the town without them knowing

coveredGames.name: ZWAARD
coveredGames.title: this is another Hyper Light-like game I think people should be checking out. on your journey to explore the world of robo-people?! you pick up, repair and customize your sword from parts you find

coveredGames.name: Nimbit Frontier
coveredGames.title: new dood in town catching almost extinct creatures, building habitats for them, release them back in the wild. zelda dungeons! we love that

coveredGames.name: About Fishing
coveredGames.title: is that mermaid hair? or just another curly fry? I guess you'll have to find out when you play

coveredGames.name: Sojourn Past
coveredGames.title: this Hyper Light-like feels so good to play. the atmosphere is mystical and the movement feels swift. I do think the teleport dagger is a little wonky but its not a game breaker for me

coveredGames.name: Order of the Sinking Star
coveredGames.title: MASSIVE "open world" puzzle game? I think so, having multiple heroes that interact with the world different with their different movesets is a really cool idea

coveredGames.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
coveredGames.title: so cute, multiple weapons the not only hurt enemies but help you solve puzzles. excited to see where the story goes and could see this being a co op game even if lil is only using the blue cursor

coveredGames.name: Anomaly President
coveredGames.title: plays like deads cells. feels good to mix weapon types into combos. building the bus and managing resource is pretty fluid once you know what everything is.

coveredGames.name: Shroom and Gloom
coveredGames.title: looking forward the brain melting double deck builder that is this game. where healing is your money is your resources for other things and you have to find the balance

coveredGames.name: BREKEKEKEX
coveredGames.title: this REALLY needs to be on controller, frog knows too much and does crazy combos if I mess up. give me pocket sand, or a hook as the frog gets stronger so i have the tools to match the frog.

coveredGames.name: Deer & Boy
coveredGames.title: watching as the two bond and grow together is the best part of this story :')

coveredGames.name: Milki Delivery
coveredGames.title: I'll find you a friend Milki!!! but also do all the side quests along the way. meeting new people across the island felt seemless and interactive

coveredGames.name: Montabi
coveredGames.title: once you understand that each of you players on the board has their OWN decks and need to play off each other. this game is bliss

coveredGames.name: Echoes of Mystralia
coveredGames.title: combat feels so fluid along with combining spells is fast and is never locked in so you can try all sorts of combos when it comes to the spell crafting

coveredGames.name: GrassChopper
coveredGames.title: I didnt HAVE to keep cutting down the grass... but i sure as HECK gonna >:D

coveredGames.name: over the hill
coveredGames.title: the winch was my best friend, the the '?" gave me things to look out for. overall the game is SO cozy and great for friends to play and chat over

coveredGames.name: Duskfade
coveredGames.title: this is amazing! the visuals and story are perfect, takes but to the PS1 era with a modern look. chronomancy is the coolest fcking power ever! I love how everything is clock theme'd in this game

coveredGames.name: BASED
coveredGames.title: its like that one party game when you were a kid and your uncle blew up a balloon and said "now don't let it hit the ground"!! the power ups are fun, the different weapons are fun, 10/10 eden devs

coveredGames.name: Heave Ho 2
coveredGames.title: if you love the first Heave Ho, Heave Ho 2 is more of the risky bean hucking business. Truly just more of the thing you love!!

coveredGames.name: WheelMates
coveredGames.title: I played the demo with a friend during the steam next fest, the puzzles and physics with the RC cars was great. levels felt like they were built for the cars, not the other way around.

coveredGames.name: Rotwood
coveredGames.title: Ready to spend even MORE time in this game now that it's out. Grinding, farming seeds and boosting gear along with the monster fight being creative and fun to play 10/10 game

coveredGames.name: Primal Light
coveredGames.title: made by only a couple of doods it really took be back to those 'quarter eater" days. where the games were challenging but fair and every life counted but also exploring every corner was important.

coveredGames.name: Furi
coveredGames.title: every fight in this game is a "crank the music, hold my beer in going in moment" each one is a perfect dance of parry on their turn slash on your turn.

coveredGames.name: Adventures of Pip
coveredGames.title: switching between the different resolutions to solve the puzzle platforming is like a minigame inside of the game! its such a unique concept and I haven't rarely seen it since I played this.

coveredGames.name: Kaze and the Wild Masks
coveredGames.title: everything but the bird mask please, also the shark mask swimming sections we're some of my favorite parts of the game!

coveredGames.name: Jotun: Valhalla Edition
coveredGames.title: GODS! this game was INREDIBLE from start to finish I never wanted to look away from the hand drawn landscapes in this game. each god felt like a real time puzzle, demanding action for a smart solution

coveredGames.name: Double Cross
coveredGames.title: I was trying to beat this game is one sitting (don't recc.) play it at you're own pace and really take in the story. its got twists and mystery to it but also the characters are fun to interact with

coveredGames.name: Hue
coveredGames.title: It should've ended at the SCHOOL, and the rest of those levels should have been optional post game. I played this game in one sitting (do not rec.) enjoy the story along the way, its a tear jerker.

coveredGames.name: Thunder Kid
coveredGames.title: a run and gun shooter topped with bullet hell bosses at the end of every "track". figuring out every boss' blind spot to sort of speed run the fight we one of my favorite parts

coveredGames.name: CODE Bunny
coveredGames.title: game had me tearing up as we follow Bunny's story through the memories. taring through enemies after marking them made this feel like speed runners would eat this game up

coveredGames.name: Gato Roboto
coveredGames.title: aww this was fun switching between being in the robot suit and doing the little cat sections. reminds me of Momodora and her ability to switch. fck that crab boss but the rest of the game is amazing

coveredGames.name: Flynn: Son of Crimson
coveredGames.title: its a short good platformer that everyone should give some time to play. collecting the golden item was one of my favorite parts but also slaying the bosses was fun once I got the Axe.

coveredGames.name: Braid
coveredGames.title: time is but a fickle thing and I'm glad a friend was playing this and then recommended it to me. games used to be love letters from the developers to the players and this one is for you. so go play it

coveredGames.name: Lost in Random™
coveredGames.title: take be back! make me forget so i can relive this story again. tim burton-esk art style, unfair living for everyone but the sixers. but we're young, spunky, and we have a dicey!

coveredGames.name: Another Crab's Treasure
coveredGames.title: don't miss the shrimp guy in the tell grass or you're gonna get stuck later on (I just feel like I shouldn't be able to skip him) also be ready to fight a final... final... final... final boss.

coveredGames.name: Ori and the Blind Forest
coveredGames.title: never play this game in one sitting, this is something you enjoy bit by bit. the story has no words but tells us so much about family

coveredGames.name: Pumpkin Jack
coveredGames.title: The shotgun’s wild 1-2-3 combo steals the show in this 3D platformer, set in a darkly whimsical, cartoony, haunted world full of spooky surprises and chaotic, playful action.

coveredGames.name: Cave Story+
coveredGames.title: Truly a classic of its time, this is one of those “important games” you need to experience firsthand. It’s not something to just watch or skip. you have to play it yourself.
